verdict.rationale: mParticle's own marketing says users can describe an audience, journey, or growth goal and the product will understand the data and suggest logic. That is a first-party natural-language interface, but it is scoped to audience and journey building and appears only as a homepage claim. missing for 10: in-depth docs on the natural-language interface, evidence it covers broader product operation beyond audience/journey building, hands-on or independent corroboration, details on whether it executes actions or only suggests logic.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Describe the audience, journey, or growth goal. mParticle understands the customer data behind it, suggests the logic to use, and helps turn intent into revenue-driving activation.
